generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the details and information regarding the works can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, PRE Division, Mandya, Karnataka, on all working days during working hours
Right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons is reserved by the Executive Engineer, PRE Division, Mandya

All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery, curing for concrete works, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer - in -charge of this work
The cost of the tender processing fee is not refundable
The Employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal
The KPWD Code, KTTP Act/Rules ,Delegation of Powers and other Government Orders issued by the Government from time to time will apply

Successful bidder submitting bids below the amount put to tender will be required to submit the difference amount in the form of FDR/TDR/DD/Pledge in the name of EE PRED Mandya within 20 days from the date of receiving the letter of acceptance as on additional security paid for unbalanced tender. Failing for which EMD will be forfeited and further action will be taken as per G O No FD PCL 2008 Bangalore Dated 14/10/2008
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately
All other terms and conditions as per tender documents of KW-1 and as per tender notification
